items.raw_desc: Társas Hammhalom:                Eat what you can with HammhalomThe Hammhalom board game is suitable for the whole family and will train your fine motor skills. The buffet offers tasty dishes - help yourself to a plate for a full meal. The aim of the game is to place the selected food on the plate so that it does not fall. Reveal the food cards, take them one by one and place the food depicted on them on your plate. Points are awarded for food placement, additional points can be earned from character cards or by building the tallest "tower" from tokens. Be careful not to let the food fall off your plate. The game ends after 7 rounds, whoever has the most points wins.
